claims.statement: Estrecho de Magallanes Central - Magallanes is the official marine ecosystem ECOMAR-058 in the Magallanes ecoregion.
SIMBIO/SBAP reports a total surface of 5,867.005 square kilometres for ECOMAR-058.
The official zone is Estrecho de Magallanes Central and its origin is classified as marina continental.
Officially listed geoforms include the Strait of Magellan, Isla Capitan Aracena, Isla Clarence, Isla Dawson, Isla Santa Ines and Peninsula Brunswick, among others.
claims.interpretation_note: Geoform membership is ecological-spatial and must not be interpreted as an administrative, legal or protected-area boundary.
